ITEM 1 | Pile of fine julienne strips, bright orange with slightly darker orange edges, matte surface with faint sheen, thin straight strips about 4-5 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, arranged in a loose mound covering roughly 30% of the plate on the left side, firm and holding shape, raw-looking with no browning or glaze | 75
ITEM 2 | Small whole round tomato, deep red with glossy skin and slight darker shading at the top, about 2.5 cm diameter, smooth and intact, sitting at upper center of plate, no cooking marks | 12
ITEM 3 | Small whole round tomato, bright red with glossy skin, about 3.5 cm diameter, smooth and intact, sitting near the center of plate beside the carrot pile, no cooking marks | 25
ITEM 4 | Small whole round tomato, red-orange with glossy skin, about 2.5 cm diameter, smooth and intact, sitting at lower right of plate, no cooking marks | 14
ITEM 5 | Two small cooked brussels sprouts, olive green to yellow-green with darker browned and slightly charred patches on outer leaves, matte and slightly moist surface, each about 2.5 cm wide and 2.5 cm tall, whole and firm, one at upper right and one at right of center | 20
ITEM 6 | One cooked brussels sprout half-browned, dark olive green with blackened charred patches and wilted outer leaves, slightly glossy, about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, lying on right side of plate | 15
ITEM 7 | Raw green bell pepper pieces, bright glossy green with pale translucent inner edges, irregular flat strips and chunks about 5-6 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, slightly curled, lying along the bottom center of the plate, no cooking marks | 40
